clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Trade District, Innkeeper Allison keeps the Gilded Rose ready for travelers and merchants. The busy inn stands between the bank and auction house, where she offers hearthstone bindings, drinks, and shelter.

Innkeeper Allison welcomes travelers at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind. The inn stands between the Trade District auction house and the city's main vaults, and its ground floor sees a steady flow of peddlers, mercenaries, and visiting diplomats. She keeps order behind the main counter and offers lodging and hearthstone services. Allison also joins local holiday festivities and coordinates small errands for traveling heroes seeking rest in the capital.
